description: Judge calibration set: hand-written answers with a KNOWN correct grade, used to measure the graders themselves. Each item reuses a question and its expected_facts from golden.json (by golden_id) and supplies a planted answer. 'label' is the grade a careful human gives. 'trap' names the mistake being tested. 'set' is basic (obvious traps) hard (mostly right, one subtle error), or holdout (written AFTER the judge prompt was tuned on basic+hard, run once with no further tuning, to check the fix generalises). Run: python judge_calibration.py

items.answer: It was not the breaker, and there was no circuit overload. The pump simply wore out.
items.label: incorrect
items.why: Mentions breaker, circuit and overload only to deny them. A substring check passes it.

items.trap: right digits inside a wrong number
items.answer: The minimum order from Verde Importers is 600 kg per lot.
items.label: incorrect
items.why: 600 is not 60, but the text '60' is inside '600'.
